metadata.description: Create a new attention span event in the MediaBridgeService.
metadata.learn_more: Create a new attention span event in the MediaBridgeService. This endpoint is used to record attention span events, which can be useful for tracking user engagement with media content. The request must include a valid JSON body conforming to the AttentionSpanEventRequest schema.

_hsenc.label: Hsenc
_hsenc.description: An encoded string used for HubSpot-specific encoding purposes.

contactId.label: Contact Id
contactId.description: The unique identifier for the contact associated with the event.

contactUtk.label: Contact Utk
contactUtk.description: The unique tracking key for the contact, used for tracking purposes.

totalPercentPlayed.label: Total Percent Played
totalPercentPlayed.description: The percentage of the media content that was played. This is a numerical value indicating how much of the total content was viewed, expressed as a percentage.

totalSecondsPlayed.label: Total Seconds Played
totalSecondsPlayed.description: The total duration in seconds that the media content was played. This is a numerical value representing the cumulative playtime.

externalId.label: External Id
externalId.description: An external identifier for the event, typically used to correlate with external systems.

externalPlayContext.label: External Play Context
externalPlayContext.description: Additional context about the play event, typically used for external integrations.

mediaBridgeId.label: Media Bridge Id
mediaBridgeId.description: The unique identifier for the media bridge instance.

mediaName.label: Media Name
mediaName.description: The name of the media involved in the event.

mediaType.label: Media Type
mediaType.description: The type of media involved in the event. Valid values include 'VIDEO', 'AUDIO', 'DOCUMENT', 'OTHER', and 'IMAGE'.

mediaUrl.label: Media Url
mediaUrl.description: The URL of the media involved in the event.

occurredTimestamp.label: Occurred Timestamp
occurredTimestamp.description: The timestamp when the event occurred, represented as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

pageId.label: Page Id
pageId.description: The unique identifier for the page where the event occurred.

pageName.label: Page Name
pageName.description: The name of the page where the event occurred.

pageUrl.label: Page Url
pageUrl.description: The URL of the page where the event occurred.

rawDataMap.label: Raw Data Map
rawDataMap.description: A map of raw data key-value pairs providing additional context about the event.

rawDataString.label: Raw Data String
rawDataString.description: A raw data string containing additional information about the event.

sessionId.label: Session Id
sessionId.description: The unique identifier for the session during which the event occurred.
